_comment: The single source of truth for this setup's Claude Code version floor.
bootstrap.mjs substitutes minimumVersion into settings.template.json at install time;
session-brief.mjs reads this file to warn when the running version is below it;
bootstrap.mjs doctor checks the running version against it.
Each feature row is [version, name, what breaks silently below it].
features: ignored - workers can spawn workers, up to five layers deep
ignored - up to 20 workers run at once
the orchestrator runs Opus 4.8, one generation behind its own design
